rules.name: cash-refresh-05-funnel-diff-cfs
rules.sql: -- Trade IDs present in BACKUP but absent in CURRENT after s1-deal filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), current_keys AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ) SELECT * FROM backup_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM current_keys

-- Trade IDs present in CURRENT but absent in BACKUP after s1-deal filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), current_keys AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ) SELECT * FROM current_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM backup_keys

-- Trade IDs present in BACKUP but absent in CURRENT after s2-paid-flags filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT d.trade_id, COALESCE(p.is_premium_paid::text, 'NULL') AS is_premium_paid, COALESCE(p.transaction_date::text, 'NULL') AS paid_transaction_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), current_keys AS ( SELECT d.trade_id, COALESCE(p.is_premium_paid::text, 'NULL') AS is_premium_paid, COALESCE(p.transaction_date::text, 'NULL') AS paid_transaction_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ) SELECT * FROM backup_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM current_keys

-- Trade IDs present in CURRENT but absent in BACKUP after s2-paid-flags filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT d.trade_id, COALESCE(p.is_premium_paid::text, 'NULL') AS is_premium_paid, COALESCE(p.transaction_date::text, 'NULL') AS paid_transaction_date FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), current_keys AS ( SELECT d.trade_id, COALESCE(p.is_premium_paid::text, 'NULL') AS is_premium_paid, COALESCE(p.transaction_date::text, 'NULL') AS paid_transaction_date FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ) SELECT * FROM current_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM backup_keys

-- Trade IDs present in BACKUP but absent in CURRENT after s2-cash-events filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = d.business_unit AND s.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera_backup_04_10.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND ( (lower(s.derivative_type) = 'future' AND ( (p.is_premium_paid = 1 AND p.transaction_date = :cob) OR (s.maturity_date = :cob AND (p.is_premium_paid = 0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) = 'not_netted') OR (lower(d.netting_status) = 'fully_netted' AND d.netting_date = :valueDate))) OR (lower(s.derivative_type) NOT IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put','future') AND ( (p.is_premium_paid = 1 AND p.transaction_date = :cob) OR (s.maturity_date = :cob AND (p.is_premium_paid = 0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) IN ('not_netted','partially_netted')) OR (lower(d.netting_status) IN ('fully_netted','partially_netted') AND d.netting_date = :valueDate))) OR lower(s.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') ) ), current_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table s ON s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = d.business_unit AND s.security_id = d.security_id LEFT JOIN opera.rms_premium_paid_table p ON p.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND p.business_unit = d.business_unit AND p.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND ( (lower(s.derivative_type) = 'future' AND ( (p.is_premium_paid = 1 AND p.transaction_date = :cob) OR (s.maturity_date = :cob AND (p.is_premium_paid = 0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) = 'not_netted') OR (lower(d.netting_status) = 'fully_netted' AND d.netting_date = :valueDate))) OR (lower(s.derivative_type) NOT IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put','future') AND ( (p.is_premium_paid = 1 AND p.transaction_date = :cob) OR (s.maturity_date = :cob AND (p.is_premium_paid = 0 OR p.is_premium_paid IS NULL) AND lower(d.netting_status) IN ('not_netted','partially_netted')) OR (lower(d.netting_status) IN ('fully_netted','partially_netted') AND d.netting_date = :valueDate))) OR lower(s.derivative_type) IN ('fx_vanilla_call','fx_vanilla_put') ) ) SELECT * FROM backup_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM current_keys

-- Trade IDs present in BACKUP but absent in CURRENT after s4-fy-premium filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera_backup_04_10.financial_year_table y ON y.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND y.start_date <= :cob AND y.end_date >= :cob JOIN opera_backup_04_10.premium_fy_table pf ON pf.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND pf.business_unit = d.business_unit AND pf.trade_id = d.trade_id AND pf.financial_year = y.financial_year WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ), current_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d JOIN opera.financial_year_table y ON y.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND y.start_date <= :cob AND y.end_date >= :cob JOIN opera.premium_fy_table pf ON pf.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND pf.business_unit = d.business_unit AND pf.trade_id = d.trade_id AND pf.financial_year = y.financial_year WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' ) SELECT * FROM backup_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM current_keys

-- Trade IDs present in BACKUP but absent in CURRENT after s3-active-lots filter WITH backup_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera_backup_04_10.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = d.business_unit AND a.trade_id = d.trade_id AND a.value_date <= :valueDate ) ), current_keys AS ( SELECT DISTINCT d.trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.is_latest_version = 1 AND lower(d.subportfolio) LIKE 'rms%' AND lower(d.subportfolio) NOT LIKE '%oid' AND lower(d.counterparty_parent) NOT LIKE 'jpm%' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.business_unit = d.business_unit AND a.trade_id = d.trade_id AND a.value_date <= :valueDate ) ) SELECT * FROM backup_keys EXCEPT SELECT * FROM current_keys
